items.title: How 3D Transforms and Figma's Agent Brought a Launch Video to Life
items.excerpt: Figma's Brand Studio team combined the new 3D transform effect (x/y/z rotation, open beta), agent-built tools, shaders and motion to make a launch video on the canvas; designs ship to code via Figma MCP.

items.title: A2UI 1.0: Build delightful, fast, reliable, agentic experiences
items.excerpt: Google ships A2UI 1.0, its generative-UI protocol that lets agents answer with interactive interface components instead of walls of text — moving agent interactions out of the 'terminal era'.

items.title: Meet your new AI Agent, plus personal cloud storage, enterprise SSO and easier variations in KeyShot Studio 2026.3
items.excerpt: KeyShot Studio 2026.3 puts an AI Agent directly inside the product-rendering app, alongside personal cloud storage, easier part variations, studio groups and enterprise SSO/MFA.

items.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
items.excerpt: Hugging Face publishes scripts and containers to LoRA-fine-tune TRELLIS.2, a popular image-to-3D model, on your own 3D assets — covering geometry and material generation, HF Jobs and local Docker runs.

items.title: SimScale launches Engineering AI Blueprint
items.excerpt: SimScale's Engineering AI Blueprint bundles NVIDIA tools and a framework for moving simulation-driven engineering AI from pilots to broader deployment.

items.title: New AI 'copilot' helps engineers design better structures
items.excerpt: MIT researchers built a generative-design copilot that pauses mid-generation to ask the human designer for feedback on regions of a structure, yielding more manufacturable parts with higher buckling loads. (Off-list: on-list CAD outlets had no fresh comparable item.)

items.title: AI is the new old design material
items.excerpt: Makers have always learned their medium by working with it, from grinding pigments to HTML; the piece argues models are the next design material and must be learned by building with them.

items.title: Every click has a price now. Who designs how that "feels"?
items.excerpt: As the all-you-can-eat AI era ends and usage-metered credits arrive, UX designers must shape how per-action AI costs feel to users.

items.title: Why are we cloning Photoshop?
items.excerpt: AI makes it easy to recreate professional creative tools; the author argues the bigger opportunity is new tool paradigms rather than vibe-coded Photoshop clones.

items.title: Designing for privacy on intelligent eyewear
items.excerpt: Google details the privacy-by-design protections built into its Gemini-powered intelligent eyewear (Android XR glasses). Note: the eyewear lineup itself already ran in gadgets — this is the design/privacy angle only.

items.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together
items.excerpt: Google Labs' Tabletop lets groups describe a custom collaborative app — itineraries, polls, brackets — and an AI canvas builds it as a shared multiplayer space; waitlist open.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Hydrogen is a fast 'daily driver' for agentic workflows and everyday coding, built to pair with Carbon and Argon in multi-model workflows via a new orchestration layer.

items.title: Config India 2026: Designing for intelligent work: inside Microsoft Copilot's new chapter
items.excerpt: Drawing on two years designing Microsoft Copilot for Windows and macOS, the talk covers why performance became a design decision, how chat, work, code and agents converged into one product, and the design system behind it.

items.title: Config India 2026: Better together: from handoff to handshake
items.excerpt: With AI putting prototyping in PMs' and engineers' hands, Atlassian shows how one team reworked the design-to-build path so the intent agreed on day one survives scattered AI-generated prototypes.

items.title: Adobe's AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
items.excerpt: The Verge rounds up Adobe MAX 2026 Sneaks — experimental AI tools including stepping inside a still photo as a navigable 3D space and 'interviewing' generated characters. Note: Adobe MAX umbrella ran 11-11; this is the Sneaks-only angle.

items.title: So, what are the best AI video generators, and how do they compare on price?
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq compares the top five AI video generators for creatives on the hidden costs behind their pricing — credits, resolution tiers and usable output per dollar.
